title: AppSourceCop Configuration
description: Schema for AppSourceCop.json — configuration for the AppSourceCop analyzer

name.description: Name of a previous version of this package to compare against for breaking changes.

publisher.description: Publisher of a previous version of this package to compare against for breaking changes.

version.description: Version of a previous version of this package to compare against for breaking changes. The baseline package must be in the baseline package cache.

baselinePackageCachePath.description: Path to the folder used as the baseline package cache. Defaults to the dependency package cache path if not specified.

mandatoryAffixes.description: Affixes that must be prepended or appended to the names of all new objects, extension objects, and fields, to prevent clashes between apps.

mandatoryPrefix.description: Required prefix for all new object, extension object, and field names.

mandatorySuffix.description: Required suffix for all new object, extension object, and field names.

supportedCountries.description: Country/region codes (alpha-2 ISO 3166) for which AppSource submissions are allowed, e.g. ["DE", "AT"].

targetVersion.description: Next Major.Minor version of the extension, used to validate ObsoleteTag values (AS0072) with the default obsoleteTagPattern. Deprecated in favor of obsoleteTagVersion.

obsoleteTagVersion.description: Next Major.Minor version of the extension, used to validate ObsoleteTag values (AS0072) with the default obsoleteTagPattern.

obsoleteTagPattern.description: Regular expression used by AS0076 to validate ObsoleteTag values. Defaults to '(\d+)\.(\d+)'.

obsoleteTagPatternDescription.description: Human-readable description of the expected obsoleteTagPattern, used when reporting AS0076 diagnostics.
